notes.title: Land of the Vikings: Spring Update
notes.content:
[h2][h3]Greetings Jarls,[/h3]

Spring equinox is behind us and the sun is shining down on our settlements. As promised last week, we just released a brand-new update for Land of the Vikings, addressing some of the issues you highlighted over the past few months – [b]from bug fixes to brand-new features.[/b]

First of all, a critical issue that previously [b]prevented the game from launching has been resolved.[/b] If you continue to run into this bug, please report it to us on Steam or Discord.

Additionally, we have added a new [b]"Return to Longhouse" button[/b] in the bottom-left menu, enabling you to quickly return to the village center with just one click or by pressing the ‘M’ key. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/355cb59d92e288b0522caf26d40ff0535827b778.png[/img]

We’ve [b]improved the Thrall notification system[/b]! Notifications related to thralls will no longer appear when there are none in your colony, streamlining your gameplay. To improve usability of workers in general, the [b]worker selection pop-up window[/b] has been expanded, making it easier to manage your resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/d2a26177611f6806c5b0fe2d3072a4ac15ca7342.png[/img]

We have made adjustments to [b]disaster balancing[/b], modifying the impact and frequency of disasters for a more enjoyable gameplay experience. We also addressed happiness issues that emerged as the population grew, ensuring a more stable environment for your villagers.

That’s it for today’s update. We hope these changes and fixes will make running your Viking village feel even smoother than before. 

[b]What change are you most excited about? [/b]

Skál!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981570/Land_of_the_Vikings/

notes.title: Fixes and Features Coming in the Next Patch!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings Jarls,[/h3]

The cruel winter months are behind us, and nature is beginning to sprawl again. To celebrate the coming of forår, or spring, we’ll be rolling out a brand new update for Land of the Vikings next week! 

Our springtime tidings include a few fixes and feature additions, requested by the community:
[list]
[*] [b]Crash Fix:[/b] A critical issue that prevented the game from launching has likely been resolved. (If you still encounter this issue, please make sure to report it to us.)
[*] [b]Return to Longhouse Button:[/b] A new button has been added to the bottom-left menu, allowing you to return to the village center with a single click. The [i]M[/i] shortcut key can also be used for this function.
[*] [b]Larger Worker Selection Window:[/b] The pop-up window for selecting workers has been enlarged for better usability.
[*] [b]Disaster Balancing:[/b] The impact and frequency of disasters have been adjusted for better game balance.
[*] [b]Happiness Adjustment:[/b] Happiness issues that arose as the population increased have been balanced.
[*] [b]Thrall Notification Fix:[/b] Notifications related to serfdom will no longer appear when there are no thralls in the village.
[*] [b]General Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b] Numerous minor issues have been addressed, along with various optimizations to improve the overall gameplay experience.[/list]

Also, if you’ve been thinking about buying Land of the Vikings and haven’t made the leap yet, the game is currently 66% off during the Steam Spring Sale!

Stay tuned for the update release next week, and thank you for your support!

Skál!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981570/Land_of_the_Vikings/

notes.title: Land of the Vikings v1.2.0: Journey to Dage Island
notes.content:
Greetings Jarls!

We're excited to announce the release of version 1.2.0 for Land of the Vikings! Expand the horizons of your Viking saga with a new free map DLC, new models, and important bug fixes based on community feedback!

[b]New Map DLC: Dage Island![/b]

Set sail and explore the mysterious shores of Dage Island, our latest map, available as a free DLC for all players. Dage Island promises a new realm of challenges and adventures, crafted to test the mettle of even the most seasoned jarls. Navigate through rugged mountainous terrains and establish your dominance in this fresh landscape, where every decision could lead to glory or peril.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/0579c67f25850b878d9941bf048bddb5564f0c32.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/38640ce392c534156d066c1f4330f1ca59be91ca.png[/img]
[b]New Models[/b]

We've visually enhanced the models for two structures in your settlements: the marketplace and the warehouse. Both have been redesigned to elevate the aesthetics of your villages.

[b]Updated Warehouse[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/2929c8df6dfaf7d792c7262f21e01bed57b6057d.png[/img]
[b]Updated Marketplace[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/3c76d16926300364c4a96d302fc630708e37c3c2.png[/img]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Shortcut Key (R) for Making Roads: Easily build roads with the new shortcut key 'R'.
[*] Camera Control Helper: Fixed the states of Q and E buttons to match the correct camera control functions.
[*] Camera Drift: Resolved the issue where the camera occasionally drifts off unexpectedly.
[*] Fishing Achievement: Corrected the "Time to Go Fishing" achievement to trigger appropriately, considering the starting fishing ships.
[*] Building Border: Fixed the issue where a red border appears when adding decorations near buildings.
[*] Statistics Panel: The statistics panel now functions correctly when the game is paused.
[*] Building Highlights: Buildings’ outlines are now highlighted properly when construction occurs while the game is paused.
[*] Productivity Display: Productivity percentage is now visible again after placing a Hunter Lodge or Gatherer Hut.
[*] Tutorial Screen: Updated the tutorial screen to correctly indicate the position of the building selection menu (bottom instead of right).
[*] Animal Ranch Employment: Addressed the bug showing incorrect employment numbers (e.g., 23/20) in fully employed animal ranches.
[*] Pathfinding: Fixed the issue where people walk through the wooden walls.
[*] Tavern Storage Expansion: Resolved the inability to expand the storage of the Tavern.
[*] Hunger Complaints: Adjusted the number of hunger complaints to dynamically change according to the population size.
[*] Improvements: Various improvements have been made to enhance your overall gaming experience. Updating to this version is beneficial.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm! Your reports and feedback are crucial in shaping the future of Land of the Vikings. We hope you enjoy exploring Dage Island and all the enhancements this update brings.

Skál!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981570/Land_of_the_Vikings/

notes.title: Land of the Vikings Update 1.1 - New Resource Management UI & New Map!
notes.content:
Greetings Jarls!

It's been a while since Land of the Vikings went 1.0 last October, and now, our first post-launch update has finally arrived, with new features, bug fixes, and challenges!

[h2]New Map: Alpine Island![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/46543366d367ca3837e8d6641c8c3431d33ced47.jpg[/img]
Embark upon the epic journey across the shores of Alpine Island, where you’ll face brand new terrain challenges while building your way to Viking glory! Designed for thoughtful strategy and exploration, this new map provides a fresh, engaging experience, with each turn brings forth new challenges and opportunities for adventure. 

[h2]New UI Management Chart System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/290dd69c0c05289505c944e8cdaa560131a79790.jpg[/img]
Our latest update blows wind into the sails of innovation with a new UI management chart system – a user-friendly tool to effortlessly track your production and resources. Get a seamless overview of your settlement, simplifying how you run your in-game economy. This feature brings a new level of clarity to resource management, enhancing your strategic planning.

[h2]New Events![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/18c11a022ccb343c0eda4b81a8710534c24a0500.jpg[/img]
We’re introducing five new events, giving you fresh experiences and tough decisions as you build your Viking settlement.

[h2]Updated Roadmap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/66b9d564f08501bba76ffc37712caecc420d1b04.jpg[/img]
We're now halfway through the post-launch roadmap, with the last remaining 2 updates coming in later this year. Adding things post-launch has been an exciting journey and we can’t wait to update you about the rest of the roadmap.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The problem of villagers not being able to pass through the Wooden Wall has been fixed.
[*] The issue where ships would go to battle and not return has been fixed.
[*] The error preventing heroes from being redeployed to battle after returning from a previous fight has been resolved.
[*]Fixed the issue where effects could not be deleted when buildings made in the Editor were added to the game.
[*]The problem of performance drop as the time spent playing the game has been resolved.
[/list]

For those that are coming back, please note that old save files will be compatible with the new version, but the statistics section will not show old save data.

Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports! We hope you'll enjoy this update, and stay tuned for more news coming in later this year for Land of the Vikings!

Skál!

notes.title: Land of the Vikings 1.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Jarls!

Today’s the day that Land of the Vikings is finally launched out of Early Access, and version 1.0 is now available! To mark this special occasion, here’s the 1.0 Release trailer below!

[previewyoutube=a_pxQf-4Bto;full][/previewyoutube]
Over the course of nearly a year in Early Access, we’ve implemented numerous content updates, improvements, system overhauls, and bug fixes. These changes were largely based on community feedback and ideas from you. So, thank you for being a part of this journey with us! If you need a recap on what came about since Early Access, we wrote about it in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1981570/view/3741985308819949356?l=english]previous blog here.[/url]

[b]New Events[/b]
[list]
[*] As you navigate your Vikings towards unrivaled glory, be prepared for the lurking shadows of treachery and the ever-mounting dangers that await your village. Brace yourself for over 20 events, ranging from raids, to charismatic commanders, and the complex demands of your village. Your leadership will be tested like never before.

[b]New Map - Volcano[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Developer Blog 6 - Looking back & Upcoming Changes in 1.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings Jarls![/b][/h2]

It’s been almost a year since we released Land of the Vikings into Steam’s Early Access program. Since then, it has seen many major updates that have brought more than 10 new & revamped features, such as the battle and runic systems, heroes, new maps, the building editor, defenses and automation, as well as over 500+ general improvements and bug fixes to the game. We’re extremely grateful to everyone who has played the game during Early Access, and provided feedback and bug reports that shaped the game into what it is now!

So before we cover all the features that’ll be coming with version 1.0, we’d like to reflect and take a look back at all the major updates that have come around during Early Access!

[h2][u][b]Looking back:[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Defense Update - Dec 21, 2022[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/214ba4a40f3a067aab423923dcb50666f16cffe3.png[/img]
From the very first major update, we introduced new defensive buildings for you to build, like the wall and watchtowers, to defend your bases against other Viking raids. As these Vikings can now attack you, you get the choice of how you’d deal with these attackers.

Not only that, the Defense update brought in many small improvements and heavily requested features like automated jobs and reassignment that make things easier to manage towards the later stages of the game, as well as reworking the tavern so that Vikings can regain their happiness.

[h3][b]Building Editor Update - Apr 4, 2023[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/81f73e5618a9dd3b2ffc13cd0582429b3884ea97.png[/img]
The next major update introduced the building editor, a powerful in-game editor that allowed you to build and personalize the look and feel of an endless variety of buildings and decorations. You can also share your creations with your friends and other players through the Steam Workshop. With over 200 workshop designs from the community, you can subscribe and pick the ones you like best and make your village unique.

[h3][b]Battle & Runic Update - Aug 31, 2023[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/a4fc46f8671635899c0ebb05399185945e21bc43.png[/img]
Lastly, our most recent update introduced many different new features. These include a runic system that grants your village abilities, heroes that will inspire and lead your Vikings into battle, a new currency - gold - that can be used to upgrade your heroes and be spent in the runics system, and a complete overhaul of the battle system that allows you to strategize and calculate the consequences based on soldier types and numbers.

Next to this, we have been meticulously going through more than 11,000 bug reports and feedback to classify, fix, and improve the game as much as we can since the Early Access release in preparation for the 1.0 release. This invaluable input has have sparked numerous quality-of-life improvements, including enhanced camera and in-game speed for specific goods and days, an expanded building editor with more meshes, and new map textures. Additionally, we've tackled various reported bugs, addressing issues such as characters climbing on top of buildings and randomly quitting jobs, save problems, and editor-related glitches. This effort was made possible by your invaluable feedback and support. We simply could not do it without you all!

Moreover, in response to your input and wishes, we brought in features like Steam cloud saves, automated tree-cutting, fresh maps, and UI enhancements aimed at enhancing village interactions.


[h2][u][b]What’s coming in 1.0:[/b][/u][/h2]
With just 1 week before the full release, we’ll be adding in the last of the features that we set out to do at the beginning, fulfilling our original vision for the game. Here’s what will be coming in the 1.0:

[h3][b]New Game Mode - Immersive Mode[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/408f3089327399125b012a1eb59c304324e1c192.gif[/img]
Take on the mantle of Jarl, and guide your Vikings through glory! In this introductory mode, it's a great starting point for new players to learn how to navigate Land of the Vikings, with more than 25 objectives exclusive to this Viking-themed story.

[h3][b]New Events[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/04bf10e072c1970e3953aa5485643d9687b1fa62.gif[/img]
As you navigate your Vikings towards unrivaled glory, be prepared for the lurking shadows of treachery and the ever-mounting dangers that await your village. Brace yourself for over 20 events, ranging from raids to charismatic commanders, and perplexing village choices. Your leadership will be tested like never before.

[h3][b]New Map - Volcano[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/8879d6be69781f8495dd350232217035e14de5be.gif[/img]
Do you have what it takes to settle on an island, with an active volcano? The new map introduces a new landscape for you to explore and settle your Vikings on, all while being in the presence of a mighty volcano!

[h3][b]New Disaster - Volcanic bombs[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/9d3235faf733a1f67dbff3cfaa42f6faff90fc36.gif[/img]
Witness the skies ablaze as volcano bombs descend upon your brave settlement. Do you have what it takes to survive this fiery trial?

Next to all this, Land of the Vikings will be available in 8 different languages, including English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Polish, Chinese, and Turkish.

[h2][b]What’s next?[/b][/h2]
With these last features being added in, we’ll be reaching a point where we have now implemented all the elements that were part of our original vision for the game. Thus, we’re happy to fully realize this dream and release the game out of Early Access! This accomplishment wouldn’t have been possible without you, and the community, and we are truly thankful for your passion and dedication to the game.

Even then, our dedication to the game remains strong. We love this game as much as you do and are determined to make it the best it can possibly be with you all. Therefore, we have a post-release roadmap in store, so stay tuned. Beyond the launch, we’ll continue to fix any bugs found, and, more importantly, we'll be excited to showcase new features and improvements, many of which have been inspired by your valuable suggestions and feedback, as well as ideas that have surfaced during the development process.

Skål!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981570/Land_of_the_Vikings/

notes.title: Battle & Runic Update is Now Live!
notes.content:
Greetings Vikings,

We're elated to finally share the Battle update we've been tirelessly working on with you. With this new rollout, the game undergoes significant transformations, introducing dozens of fresh features.

[h2]Battle System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/d297324f3748a8ef35d6049ca9ced0f94b668ea3.jpg[/img]
Battles are no longer determined by a single choice. Now, depending on the number and type of soldiers you have, you can devise a myriad of strategies, offering a renewed gameplay mechanism.

For a more comprehensive breakdown, refer to our previous blog post.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1981570/view/3674421166725375737

[h2]Heroes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/e1be0388456526a4a47928e4634d4b5f02200b20.png[/img]
As your village flourishes and gains fame, it will begin to pique the interest of heroes. These valiant figures will lead your troops into battle, providing various bonuses along the way. But remember, no hero serves without compensation. They will have weekly demands in the form of silver and various resources. It is imperative to meet their needs consistently, ensuring the continued loyalty and happiness of these champions.

[h2]Runics[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/358ed2b65e7bde2086403b24714a39438c35357b.png[/img]
Runics introduce a system that grants your village temporary or permanent abilities and benefits alongside the Tree of Life. However, accessing the Runics requires reaching specific milestones. Once these milestones are attained, you can unlock these features using Tree of Life points and gold.

[h2]Gold[/h2]

Gold makes its grand debut in the game as a new currency. Earn gold through certain objectives and victorious battles. The amassed gold can be invested in upgrading your heroes and can be put to good use in the new Runic system.



[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
[b]New Map: [/b]Introducing "Alone Island".
[b]Camera Speed:[/b] Default camera speed has been increased by 1.5x. (This can be adjusted in settings.)
[b]Climbing Issue:[/b] Fixed the problem where characters were climbing on top of buildings.
[b]Edge Scroll Setting:[/b] Added an option to enable/disable edge scrolling.
[b]Game Speed:[/b] Maximum game speed has been increased. (From x10 to x12.)
[b]Save Issue:[/b] Resolved a crash issue originating from saved games.
[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b] Numerous minor bugs have been addressed and improvements have been implemented.

In every battle, behind every strategy, and through every milestone, remember that the spirit of a true Viking never wavers. Embrace these updates and let the sagas of your victories echo through the ages!

Until next time, may your axes stay sharp and your shields stay strong.
[url=https://discord.gg/ndkDUpm6SW][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/29e372f9749cf54ce498971d60f20e8bcf18791e.png[/img][/url]

[I] We advise to use a new save to avoid potential incompatibility If you want to go over the old save, you can download the LOTV 0.8.1v version from the beta.[/i]

notes.title: Developer Blog 5 - Battle Changes & Heroes
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, Jarls!
[/h1]

To start, we would like to express our gratitude for your interest in the game and for the 11,000+ in-game feedback messages and the bug reports from Discord and Steam forums that you've sent us. Rest assured, we are reading all of your feedback and are continuing to develop and grow the game with your support.

Now, we would like to talk about our exciting upcoming update: [b]Changes to the Battle System and Heroes!
[/b]
[h2]Heroes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/e1be0388456526a4a47928e4634d4b5f02200b20.png[/img]
Once your village reaches a certain size and fame, Viking heroes will want to become a part of your village. These heroes will inspire confidence in your villagers and will be able to command your warriors in battle. However, these heroes will require a special house and will have specific demands, including silver. It's crucial to meet these needs, or else the heroes of your village might become your most formidable foes!

[h2]Battle System
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/d297324f3748a8ef35d6049ca9ced0f94b668ea3.jpg[/img]
The battle system is now changing. While previously the outcome of a battle was determined with a single click, you will now be able to issue commands to your soldiers, observing the consequences and gains before making a decision. This system allows for varying strategies based on your soldiers, your commander, and the villages and cities you are attacking. It's crucial to analyze your potential gains and losses well, and focus on winning the battle!

[h2]New Map
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/9c1ff6bca8e1dc491fc5f6b6017a7ffce1fe2656.jpg[/img]
A gorgeous island map with brand-new textures, trees, and plant species will be added to the game in the next update. This map, with its variable terrain and resources, will certainly challenge you!

The upcoming update will come along with numerous bug fixes, improvements, and better performance. If you'd like to learn about the updates more quickly and communicate with us, you can join our Discord channel.

[h3]Until next time, Skål!
[/h3]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/UxbyegwasH][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/29e372f9749cf54ce498971d60f20e8bcf18791e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Customize Your Viking Village With Your Own Designs!
notes.content:
Hello Jarls! 

Building your own Viking village can be one of the most enjoyable experiences in the game. However, we want to talk about a feature that can truly make your village unique: the ability to create and share your own building and decoration designs.

notes.title: Developer Blog 4 - Building Editor
notes.content:
Hello Jarls!!
We've been quiet for a long time, but it's because we've been working hard on our next big update. But now, the time has come to introduce you to the upcoming update: the [b]Building Editor![/b]

The Building Editor is a powerful in-game editor that you will be able to access from the main menu, and will allow you to build an unlimited number of buildings and decorations. Customize the look of most in-game buildings with all kinds of decorations and other details! 

[h1]What's in the Building Editor?[/h1]

You will not need a previous modeling background to use the Building Editor. Thanks to the editor's easy-to-use and simple interface, you will be able to start creating decorations or buildings in a few minutes. There are nearly 300 ready-to-use meshes in the editor. The number of these meshes will continue to increase and diversify with each update!

[h3]Make Your Own Decorations[/h3]

Decorations are a structure that can be put in the game without the need for an installation and give various effects. Likewise, before you start making decorations in the editor, you can select at least 1 (and at most 2) effects that the decoration will affect. These effects will provide you with various bonuses in the game. After choosing the decoration effects, you can easily create your decoration with the editor and you can see your own decorations on the last page in the build menu in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/ee159b4df1e9d2b51a0c8b18f85052c72a3e9ee9.jpg[/img]

[h3]Make Your Own Buildings[/h3]

Making buildings in the editor is a little different than making decorations. You may have noticed that when villagers build in-game, they first place the supporting pillars and you can actually watch the construction being built from the ground up. This is one of our favorite features (and it seem you all like it, too!) 

So, we added this feature to the editor! After finishing the design of your building, the editor will ask you to choose the pillars of the building. Here you will be able to decide the sequence of how the construction will be built in-game. Then you can see this in action when you order construction of that building type in your Viking village! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/f17c0a84b0a5671008abf96a708d7d9f68b059d0.jpg[/img]


[b]Here's a glimpse of the Building Editor in action:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/113375658be184ef762b7bb0a8ba4c3da18c3746.gif[/img]

You can also share decorations and buildings you've made, with your friends and other players through the Steam Workshop. So the Building Editor really is for everyone! You can simply grab others' awesome creations and use them in your game. 

[h3]What else??[/h3]

Thanks to your feedback, we continue to improve the game in line with your wishes and feedback with each update. In the next update, Steam Cloud (Only windows), quality of life updates, bug fixes, and a new map are also coming!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/5c09b427357f512d5e2bdb605335f1377c188c96.jpg[/img]

We just couldn't wait any longer without telling you all about the Building Editor Update. This new feature is coming very soon, so stay tuned!

If you have questions about the editor update, you can contact us via Discord!

notes.title: Land of the Vikings — The Defense Update Is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Jarls!

Our first content update is here! The Defense Update brings you many small improvements that a lot of you have been asking for, including automatic recruitment, village defense, and tavern improvement. Without further ado, let's take a look at all the new content in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/3c84d59d103b45a2b22eadb02540345b6a6c0934.png[/img]

[h2]Automated Jobs[/h2]

As the game progressed and the population increased, we realized that many tasks such as planting fields, reassigning workers, etc. took a lot of players' time and could cause difficulties. That's why we added some new features to make things easier for players in the mid and late-game. Certain nodes in the Tree of Life must be discovered before these features can be used.

[b]Auto Worker Assign.[/b] With this feature, you allow the game to assign the best workers for you with a single button instead of looking for workers one by one from the buildings. This means you can spend your time on more important matters than personally inspecting every viking in the village.

[b]Auto Replace Workers.[/b] With this feature, an available worker is immediately assigned to replace the employee who leaves the job in any way. You cannot manually assign workers to the job when this feature is turned on.

[b]Auto Ship Repair.[/b] When ships take too much damage, they are automatically brought to an empty Shipyard to be repaired. You can turn this setting on from the Shipyard.

[b]Auto Plant-Harvest.[/b] By using this feature, you can enable farmers to constantly plant and harvest fields that you're using.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/d62611b5be56b6a5e1d981c992b4526c62d7a7d1.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Tavern[/h2]
There was a tavern in the game before, but it was not functional (apart from looking pretty). With this update, the tavern is now fully operational. When Vikings are unhappy, they come to the tavern and find happiness by feasting and drinking with friends.

[h2]Defense[/h2]

Now other villages can attack you too! So think twice before going out for a raid. What if another village comes to plunder you while your soldiers are plundering? If you cannot defend your village, you may have to give every item you have to the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/cb2ff6a00ab6b84e44636c0ee263ee4b363ccaf1.jpg[/img]

By installing the newly added defensive buildings, the Wall and Watchtowers, you can defend your village against future attacks. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/a65ab79ca29f639effa6526dae91198a07e2bbe2.jpg[/img]

You can get rid of the attackers coming to your village in several ways. For example, you can give them what they want to resolve things peacefully, or you can attack them and make them regret ever coming to your shores. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/88605b1b278c85375e28583f0893eb35df9c8f6d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Misc. changes[/h2]

Some smaller changes we made based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] 1-day duration in the game increased by 20%.
[*] Trees will spawn 25% faster.
[*] Warrior training fees have increased.
[/list]

That's it from us! We'll be back with more news on upcoming updates in the new year. For now, Merry Yuletide, and enjoy the Defense Update!

notes.title: Land of the Vikings Roadmap Revealed!
notes.content:
Hello Jarls,

It's been 3 weeks since the Early Access release of Land of the Vikings, and we are absolutely floored with the amount of messages we've received. Comments, forum posts, feedback, bug reports, everything. Thank you all very much, it's clear that you're all very passionate about the game, which is wonderful to see. Your in-game feedback has already exceeded 5 thousand messages, so we've got plenty to work with!

We've already been updating the game with smaller patches to tackle common pieces of feedback (like being able to turn off disasters), and we will continue to do so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/0777a8180af9f510f80c8b0d43886f0d09295222.jpg[/img]

Now let's get into the future of Land of the Vikings. Next up on the docket is the [i]Defense Update[/i], coming in the next few months. With this update, your village will be open to attacks from the outside, so it is up to you to organize a proper defense by placing walls and decorations to deter attackers.

At the same time, there will be changes in the happiness system with the Defense Update. As the population grows, villagers will be more restless, and you will need to indulge them with drinks in the taverns (working Tavern confirmed!) to keep them happy.

The most requested feature, automatic worker assignment, will also come with this update.

After the Defense Update, we have plans for multiple major updates. Take a look at our roadmap below! (Click for the full resolution)

[url=https://i.imgur.com/UJ13j4a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/02b7e03b0ba44aa99a14b896c17b50cc01105dd5.jpg[/img][/url]

We'll be back with more news as we get closer to the other updates, but we'll give you a little spoiler for now. The first upcoming major update will include Steam Workshop support and a building editor that allows you to create and share your very own buildings!

Thank you again for your support, and we'll see you in the next blog.

Skål

- The Land of the Vikings team

Greetings, Jarls!

Odin smiles upon us this day. We are very excited to announce that [b]Land of the Vikings is now available in Early Access![/b]

[previewyoutube=UaLwFr17ors;full][/previewyoutube]

Build the Viking village of your dreams, manage your people carefully, go raiding for supplies, and survive terrible disasters. You can pick up Land of the Vikings at €/$19,99 with a 10% discount during our launch week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1981570/Land_of_the_Vikings/

[h2]What is in Early Access?[/h2]

[h3]Four unique maps[/h3]
At EA launch, there will be four playable maps, each with their own quirks and sizes. Some offer more of a challenge than others, like the [i]White Rivers[/i] map, where resources are both scarce and far away from civilization. If you're looking for even more of a challenge, there are also difficulty settings to further spice things up.

[*] And more!
[/list]

We're so excited to embark on this Early Access journey, and we hope to see you on the forums and on Discord.

notes.title: Devlog #1 — Making Land of the Vikings
notes.content:
Dear Vikings,

Welcome to our very first devlog! In this first issue, we'll talk about how we got started on Land of the Vikings, the development process, and some hidden (👀) features. 

[h3]The Team[/h3]

Before going into the details, let's introduce you to our developer team. Our team consists of 3 heroes: Onurhan Akçay, Mustafa Burak Gören, and Erhan Yılmaz. A three man squad of 1 software developer, 1 character artist, and 1 environmental artist. In typical indie studio fashion, everyone had to learn additional skills to make Land of the Vikings work. All programming is done by Onurhan, the software developer. Character, animation, and UI works belonged to Burak, and Erhan was responsible for level design, 3D solid models, assets, effects, and music(!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/4ef146b829a2692d94f801ef7ab822c170f5c560.jpg[/img]
The developer team (Burak, Erhan, Onurhan)

[h3]Why Land of the Vikings?[/h3]
We wanted to develop a more organic and living game and we thought how well it would go with the Viking theme. We love Viking culture and its deep mythology. All of their Gods, stories, and creatures have created a huge universe that we can translate into the game. After a development process that lasted for about 2 years, it already came in a concrete form via the demo.

We want to make the game as free, dynamic and fantastic as possible, so it's not a game based on history. There are supernatural events in the game, gods you can ask for help and seers who will tell you what will happen at a price!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/66dc023aab7dc8dad6fd677f4a06fb7f89eaecbb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Let's Choose An Engine[/h3]
Today, when it comes to game engines, two of the most well-known game engines come to mind: Unity and Unreal Engine. Instead of comparing 2 game engines here, we would like to briefly tell you why we chose to develop in Unreal Engine. The biggest reason we chose UE is simply experience; our team was more experienced with UE, so we went with the more comfortable choice. 

Onurhan previously developed games with UE4, Erhan's works in the UE marketplace for more than 6 years and Burak has 2 years of experience working with UE4. "But what about Unreal Engine 5?" you ask. We'd like to say that it was a decision we made after much deliberation, but in reality we had already gotten to work on the game before UE5 was announced. So we decided to stick with the latest version of UE4.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/29b0d4c100bef15119db37ea25b6a546724db85e.jpg[/img]

UE4 was working successfully in many aspects such as lighting, navigation, etc., but I cannot say the same for modding support. We didn't want the players to only use the models [i]we[/i] made in the game. That's why we've also developed a building editor where players can use their own decorations and buildings in-game... (oops, can you keep that a secret between us? We promised not to tell anyone yet...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/4901bb46f41e871556f8d400f9ef502deb2adc3d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]
City-building games are very detailed and have many different mechanics. Therefore, it is very important that each mechanic works in harmony with each other. At the same time, the in-game balance needs to be adjusted very well for the player to enjoy the game more.

We want to add much more content to our game, fix any bugs that pop up, and most importantly, we will continue to improve the game while keeping your feedback in mind. To get continuous feedback from you, we decided Early Access was the best choice. Thankfully the wait won't be [i]too[/i] long. (Soon™)

That's it for our first devlog Vikings, we will continue to explain our game with new blogs very soon!

Skål!

notes.title: Land of the Vikings Early Access Coming Q4 2022!
notes.content:
Vikings!

Hermóðr has come with wonderful tidings. We are excited to announce that Land of the Vikings will enter Early Access in Q4 of 2022! Learn all you need to know about our gridless city builder in our brand new trailer ⚒

[previewyoutube=UxYdW9hdMPM;full][/previewyoutube]

Exciting, right? Here's a list of things you can expect from Land of the Vikings:

[list]
[*] Gridless building! You can place your buildings anywhere, making your community one of a kind.
[*] Know your vikings. With 22 different characteristics, no two villagers are the same.
[*] 30 unique buildings to build, each important to your people's health and prosperity.
[*] Enlist the aid of the Gods by building totems to Freya, Tyr, Odin, and Thor.
[*] Survive deadly disasters like earthquakes, thunder storms, and blizzards.
[*] Progress through Yggdrasil, the tech tree of life, to unlock new bonuses and buildings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555519/e49ee4138a4291f17c1d837066b33d28096191af.png[/img]

And that's not the only exciting news! We're also enabling the demo again to celebrate our time at Gamescom! If you missed out during the Steam Survival event, now's your chance to get some building in.

If you have any feedback on the demo, feel free to leave it on the Steam forums, or join the community on Discord!
